answer: A key joins only when unrelated sponsors each lock 50 canyon behind it. Meadow links keys whose deposits trace to one source, and the n-th linked key needs n sponsors who back no other key in its cluster. Each sponsor signs a thread naming its key, and if meadow judges that key's work forged, everyone on that thread forfeits their canyon. An honest newcomer needs one sponsor. 100 linked clones need 5,050 distinct sponsors risking 252,500 canyon, unless the operator buys a separately verified exchange account to fund each clone.
